name: ICTC Enterprise Candidate UI/UX and Certification-Evidence Contract

model: task-first surfaces; plain-language labels; capability-driven actions; evidence and technical detail disclosed on demand

globalInvariants.name: one-primary-intent
globalInvariants.statement: Every operational surface exposes one primary intent in the first viewport.

globalInvariants.name: plain-language-first
globalInvariants.statement: Primary titles and actions use common Italian; internal terms are deferred to detail.

globalInvariants.name: capability-truth
globalInvariants.statement: Visible actions correspond to server-issued capabilities and read-only roles expose zero write controls.

globalInvariants.name: state-action-effect
globalInvariants.statement: Every record exposes current state, next available action and expected effect without duplicate status copy.

globalInvariants.name: bounded-first-viewport
globalInvariants.statement: Orientation, current state and primary action fit within a bounded first viewport at supported desktop sizes.

globalInvariants.name: progressive-disclosure
globalInvariants.statement: Method, proof, technical configuration and historical detail are separated and disclosed independently.

globalInvariants.name: information-density
globalInvariants.statement: Empty states and low-cardinality lists do not reserve dashboard-sized space.

globalInvariants.name: standard-action-placement
globalInvariants.statement: Primary actions are placed before secondary explanation and remain adjacent to their object.

globalInvariants.name: evidence-boundary
globalInvariants.statement: Proof, audit trail and AI traces are represented as evidence of recorded operations, not truth or certification.

globalInvariants.name: responsive-and-zoom
globalInvariants.statement: The UI remains operable at 320px, 390px, landscape mobile and 200 percent zoom without horizontal loss.

globalInvariants.name: keyboard-and-focus
globalInvariants.statement: Navigation, dialogs and disclosures support logical keyboard order, Escape close and focus restoration.

globalInvariants.name: audience-composition
globalInvariants.statement: Consultants, auditors, certifiers and public authorities can find system text, evidence composition, limits and standard mappings without exposing operational writes.

globalInvariants.name: human-authority
globalInvariants.statement: AI assistance is visibly subordinate to human approval, verification, submission and closure.

globalInvariants.name: identity-separation
globalInvariants.statement: Federated access policy and local identity lifecycle are represented as distinct administrative concepts.

globalInvariants.name: minimal-certification-view
globalInvariants.statement: A certification reviewer can traverse summary, control, evidence, limitation and machine-readable artifact with no decorative duplication.

definitionOfDone: All 11 supplied image surfaces are mapped to code, backend capability and a verified UI change.
The terminal UI module is installed after the 1.8 compatibility layers and is reversible as one slice.
Primary labels contain no unexplained job, novelty or baseline terminology.
Home separates method from proof and does not auto-expand either group for auditors.
Monitoring and event records expose object, state, next action and proof in a compact row.
Administration uses a section navigator and renders one active work surface at a time.
Federated access and local identity lifecycle are separate administration sections.
Proof view uses an operational title, explicit metric labels and a visible claim boundary.
All visible write controls are derived from server-issued capabilities.
Auditor browser journeys find zero write controls in operational and administration surfaces.
Eleven deterministic screenshots are produced by the browser assurance journey.
Desktop, 320px, 390px, mobile landscape and 200 percent zoom show no material horizontal overflow.
Keyboard tests cover navigation, disclosure, dialog open, Escape close and focus return.
Long Italian copy and unbroken identifiers do not clip status or evidence content.
Reduced motion and forced colors retain state and focus information.
Saturation executes the declared T dimensions, reaches M and confirms no new risk primitive at M+100.
Compression supplies one distinguishing witness for every retained global invariant.
Certification proof artifacts are generated for every certificationProofDimension.
The proof package states that external certification and authority approval remain external activities.
Existing 1.4, 1.6, 1.7, 1.8, identity, runtime and security contracts remain green.
No backend endpoint, permission or evidence claim is invented by the UI slice.
The branch remains separate from main and is identified as a pre-PR candidate until all remote gates are green.
